extraction.Name: Louis McDonald
extraction.Recorded patent: yes, filed for record; Delivered at Agency; receipted for by Allottee
extraction.Buyer: not stated; sold for $5000.00, full value, to settle $2000 old debts, about Sept. 1918
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: sold to settle $2000 old debts; allottee says he received full value for his land
extraction.Occupation/Income: Allottee works for 101 Ranch; has inherited interests that bring him about $55.00 per annum
extraction.NOTES: Date of document: November 1928; notarized in Kay County, State of Oklahoma, Ponca City, Okla.; commission expires Aug. 3rd; wife and three children dependent on allottee; land has not been sold for debt or taxes; no date of redemption expired; document references Circular No. 2464, June 18, 1928; file reference 61391
